summary: RAG-critique-revise topology on LoRA adapter v2a_e1
hypothesis: Combining the ragCritiqueRevise in-context topology (exp005) with the champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1 should yield additive gains — the adapter's fine-tuned judgment plus the retrieval-and-revision pipeline should push quality beyond either alone.
technique: A matrix sweep crossing all inference topologies against the best LoRA adapter: here, the exp005 RAG→generate→critique/revise pipeline is re-run with the v2a_e1 LoRA adapter swapped in at every model call, testing whether the adapter generalises to a multi-stage in-context topology.
result: Scored 0.372 on the full-30 greedy gate, up from the raw exp005 baseline (0.315) but well below the champion exp056 (0.440). The topology + adapter combination did not transfer the champion's gains, so the run was discarded; the cross-sweep reveals the adapter's benefit is topology-sensitive.
